title: Main-hit micro-choreography

checks.name: push accelerates (speed rises into the snap)
at most one big flash per second, <= 2 frames
negative control: a 2 Hz sway is not the impact frequency

program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    pass
    fps = 60
    T = 1.6

    def pos(t):
        if t < 0.4:
            return -20 * math.sin(math.pi * t / 0.4 / 2) ** 2 * (1 if t < 0.4 else 0)
        if t < 0.7:
            u = (t - 0.4) / 0.3
            return -20 + 220 * u ** 3
        return 200.0
    hit = 0.7

    def shake(t):
        if t < hit:
            return 0.0
        u = t - hit
        return 8 * math.exp(-u / 0.13) * math.sin(2 * math.pi * 11 * u)
    imgs = []
    flash = []
    for f in range(int(T * fps)):
        t = f / fps
        im, d = canvas(320, 100)
        x = 40 + pos(t) + shake(t)
        fl = 1.0 if hit <= t < hit + 2 / fps else 0.0
        flash.append(fl)
        if fl:
            d.rectangle([0, 0, 320, 100], fill=(255, 255, 255))
        d.rectangle([x, 40, x + 20, 60], fill=(255, 80, 80))
        imgs.append(np.asarray(im))
    mp4 = write_mp4(wd / 'main_hit.mp4', imgs, fps)
    fr = read_mp4(mp4, 320, 100)
    xs = []
    for q in fr:
        m = (q[:, :, 0] > 180) & (q[:, :, 1] < 150)
        xs.append(float(np.nonzero(m)[1].mean()) if m.any() else float('nan'))
    xs = np.array(xs)
    post = xs[int((hit + 2 / fps) * fps) + 1:]
    sig = post - 250.0
    sig = sig - sig.mean()
    spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(sig * np.hanning(len(sig)), n=1024))
    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(1024, 1 / fps)
    peak = float(freqs[int(np.argmax(spec[1:])) + 1])
    env = np.abs(np.array([shake(hit + 2 / fps + (i + 1) / fps) for i in range(len(post))]))
    a0 = float(np.abs(sig[:8]).max())
    a1 = float(np.abs(sig[16:24]).max())
    tau = 16 / fps / math.log(a0 / a1) if a1 > 0 else 0
    dip = float(np.nanmin(xs[:int(0.4 * fps)]) - xs[0])
    flashes_per_s = sum((1 for a, b in zip(flash, flash[1:]) if b and (not a))) / T
    path = jw(wd / 'main_hit.json', {'x': [None if math.isnan(v) else v for v in xs.tolist()], 'shake_peak_hz': peak, 'tau': tau})
    checks = [check('anticipation dip before the push', dip < -15, dip, '~-20 px'), check('push accelerates (speed rises into the snap)', xs[int(0.69 * fps)] - xs[int(0.68 * fps)] > xs[int(0.5 * fps)] - xs[int(0.49 * fps)], [xs[int(0.5 * fps)] - xs[int(0.49 * fps)], xs[int(0.69 * fps)] - xs[int(0.68 * fps)]], 'rising'), check('shake measured at ~11 Hz', abs(peak - 11) <= 1.0, peak, 11), check('shake decays with tau ~0.13 s', 0.09 <= tau <= 0.18, tau, 0.13), check('at most one big flash per second, <= 2 frames', flashes_per_s <= 1 and sum(flash) <= 2, [flashes_per_s, sum(flash)], '<=1/s, <=2 f')]
    swayf = 2.0
    sway = [8 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * swayf * i / fps) for i in range(len(post))]
    sp2 = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(np.array(sway) * np.hanning(len(sway)), n=1024))
    checks.append(check('negative control: a 2 Hz sway is not the impact frequency', abs(float(freqs[int(np.argmax(sp2[1:])) + 1]) - 11) > 3, float(freqs[int(np.argmax(sp2[1:])) + 1]), 11))
    return (checks, [mp4, path])
